min_standing_note.value: CAU does not enforce a strict incoming minimum GPA (Fall 2025 Fact Sheet #page=6: 'CAU does not have strict GPA requirements. Students nominated by their home universities will be deemed qualified'); Spring 2026 Fact Sheet specifies maintaining Minimum 2.0/4.5 (75/100) for the whole semester.

value: Graduate School (except Global MBA and GSIS)
excluded_majors.notes: At graduate level only Global MBA (business/economics majors) and GSIS (business/economics/IR majors) accept exchange students.

min_gpa_host.notes: Fall 2025 Fact Sheet (#page=6, confirmed via cau.ac.kr) explicitly states 'CAU does not have strict GPA requirements. Students nominated by their home universities will be deemed qualified', and Spring 2026 Fact Sheet (#page=6) drops the 4.0 conversion table and specifies only Minimum 2.0/4.5 (75/100) for the whole semester.

english_course_availability.notes: Over 900 courses per academic year are offered in English across departments; primary university instruction is in Korean.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: None formally required; English proficiency equivalent to TOEFL iBT 80 (pBT 550 / CBT 210) or IELTS 5.5 is recommended (especially for Graduate School).
english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.notes: Fall 2025 Fact Sheet (#page=6) notes recommendation applies especially at graduate level. No RHET 1020 exemption stated.

fall_term_dates.value: Sep 1 – Dec (16 weeks); dorm check-in and mandatory orientation in the last week of August.

spring_term_dates.value: Mar 2 – Jun (16 weeks); dorm check-in and mandatory orientation in the last week of February.

tuition_model.notes: Official CAU site confirms Student Exchange Program participants from partner universities study tuition-waived (Visiting Students pay tuition).

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Prorated from CAU Spring 2026 Fact Sheet official 16-week (~4-month) semester budget of $4,300 USD ($1,300 dorm + $700 meals + $600 transport + $200 books + $1,500 personal) = $1,075 USD/month.

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5 months * 1075 USD/month midpoint = 5375.00 USD (rate 1 USD = 1 USD; verified 2026-11-15). Prorated from CAU Spring 2026 Fact Sheet official 16-week (~4-month) semester budget of $4,300 USD ($1,300 dorm + $700 meals + $600 transport + $200 books + $1,500 personal) = $1,075 USD/month.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory South Korean National Health Insurance (NHIS) enrollment upon Residence Card issuance at ~USD 70/month; private home insurance does not exempt from NHIS.
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Optional intensive Korean language courses carry a 25% discount for exchange students.

housing_availability.notes: On-campus dorms assigned first-come, first-served with highly limited/competitive availability; TB test within 4 weeks prior required; no overseas dorm payment (pay in KRW cash on arrival).

housing_notes.value: Seoul Campus dorm approx. $1,300 USD/semester; Da Vinci (Anseong) Campus dorm approx. $850 USD/semester (#page=6); meals not included. Competitive first-come, first-served placement (Spring applications Dec, Fall applications Jun; #page=4); TB test within 4 weeks prior and local dorm payment required (#page=5).
housing_notes.notes: Application periods covered on #page=4; cancellation, TB test, and no-overseas-payment rules covered on #page=5.

host_grants_or_stipends.value: No general automatic stipend; Fall 2025 Fact Sheet notes potential candidates for student scholar roles or internships are contacted directly by email.

citizenship_restrictions.value: Passport valid >=6 months post-stay required. Additional visa/immigration documentation required for nationals of 26 designated countries including Egypt; non-OECD and Chinese nationals must submit couriered original transcripts with Apostille/Consular authentication/CHSI.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: D-2-6 Exchange Student Visa (single-entry prior to Residence Card); post-arrival RC processing takes 7–10 weeks. Financial proof of > USD 6,000 (1 semester) or > USD 12,000 (1 year) issued within 30 days required (add'l docs for Egypt & 25 other nationals).

course_catalog_url.notes: Dynamic CAU TIS course timetable portal.

english_course_list_url.notes: No static English-only URL; use CAU TIS course portal (https://cautis.cau.ac.kr/TIS/websquare/websquare.html?w2xPath=%2FTIS%2Fstd%2Fusk%2FsUskSif005_eng.xml) and filter by English-taught courses.

course_restrictions_note.value: Business Administration & Art courses closed to non-majors in Period 1; Art restricted to art majors across all 3 periods; Architecture requires accredited matching major + prerequisites; graduate students cannot take undergraduate courses.

value: Official academic transcript (couriered original with Apostille/Consular authentication/CHSI for non-OECD & Chinese nationals)
Bank balance certificate (> USD 6,000/sem issued within 30 days + sponsorship letter if applicable)

campus_type.notes: Two campuses: Seoul Campus and Da Vinci (Anseong) Campus.

international_support_services.value: OIA exchange coordination, mandatory pre-term orientation, group Residence Card (RC) application service, GLAM student buddy program, and Korean Language Center (https://korean.cau.ac.kr/english/index.php?mid=n00).

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Term: Nomination April, Application May; Spring Term: Nomination October (prior year), Application November (prior year).
